rationale: C14 is an unmistakable concrete drafting template for the child. The two proclamations have the same title and reproduce nearly the entire recital-and-operative structure, often verbatim, while principally updating the quota year, hearing date, and list of intervening proclamations. Both concern the same 1,500,000-pound supplemental quota for the same precisely defined harsh or rough cotton. C15 and C25 use closely related section 22 supplemental-cotton-quota machinery, but their different cotton categories, quantities, licensing provisions, and operative details make them weaker than C14.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the United States Tariff Commission has made a supplemental investigation to determine whether changed circumstances require the modification of the said proclamation of September 5, 1939, to permit an additional quantity of harsh or rough cotton having a staple of 1 1/8 inches or more but less than 1 3/8 inches in length
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the United States Tariff Commission has made a supplemental investigation to determine whether changed circumstances require the modification of the said proclamation of September 5, 1939, to permit an additional quantity of harsh or rough cotton having a staple of 1 1/8 inches or more but less than 1 3/8 inches in length
shared_material.explanation: This distinctive description of the supplemental investigation and targeted cotton is reproduced verbatim, with the surrounding quota-year dates updated.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the Commission has recommended that an additional quantity of 1,500,000 pounds of harsh or rough cotton (except cotton of perished staple, grabbots, and cotton pickings), white in color, and having a staple of 1 3/16 inches or more but less than 1 3/8 inches in length be permitted entry
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the Commission has recommended that an additional quantity of 1,500,000 pounds of harsh or rough cotton (except cotton of perished staple, grabbots, and cotton pickings), white in color, and having a staple of 1 3/16 inches or more but less than 1 3/8 inches in length be permitted entry
shared_material.explanation: The exact quantity, exclusions, color, staple range, and recommendation formula are shared.

shared_material.child_excerpt: do hereby find and declare, on the basis of the said supplemental investigation and report of the United States Tariff Commission, that changed circumstances require the modification of the said proclamation of September 5, 1939
shared_material.parent_excerpt: do hereby find and declare, on the basis of the said supplemental investigation and report of the United States Tariff Commission, that changed circumstances require the modification of the said proclamation of September 5, 1939
shared_material.explanation: The operative finding and modification mechanism are identical.

shared_material.child_excerpt: which additional quantity I hereby find and declare may be entered for consumption, or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption, during such quota year without rendering or tending to render ineffective or materially interfering with the domestic program undertaken with respect to cotton
shared_material.parent_excerpt: which additional quantity I hereby find and declare may be entered for consumption, or withdrawn from warehouse for consumption, during such quota year without rendering or tending to render ineffective or materially interfering with the domestic program undertaken with respect to cotton
shared_material.explanation: The same statutory compatibility finding closes the operative provision in both directives.
